worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.summary: Approach a real wall and climb upward, cresting only after your feet clear its edge and your body fits. Ceilings and budgets stop the climb. On flat ground use one low pounce; only real body contact deals a strike and possible confusion.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.use.1: Leap a short distance into a group
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.use.2: Climb a real short ledge to reach high ground
Rushes up to %2$s blocks, striking the first enemy for about %1$s damage; hits only %3$s contacted target.
On a solid hit, %1$s chance to leave the target confused for %2$s; while confused, each action it starts has %3$s chance to be broken, and that action is wasted.
Original aim spread is %1$s degrees per missing accuracy point; climb up to %2$s blocks, with native collision limiting reach.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.vault.on: Vault: farther and higher, but slower, slightly lighter per hit, with longer startup/cooldown and wider aim spread.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.vault.off: Low pounce: short, low and quick; sufficiently low real walls can still be climbed.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.growth.0: From level %1$s the pounce power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.growth.1: From level %1$s the pounce power rises to %2$s and the confuse chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.preference.v: On: leaps farther and higher with a bigger scuff, but longer windup/recover/cooldown and a wider aim spread (easier to miss). Off (Ground Pounce): a low, fast pounce with a tighter spread and more consistency, at the cost of range and radius.
worldcombat.skill.rockclimb.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first; the leap is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
On: lower-health targets rank higher for the finishing pounce; off: all targets rank alike.
Prefer elevated targets behind a real short wall.
Claw marks appear only briefly on real wall contact. Terrain remains intact.
